view.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a brightly lit convenience store aisle. Shelves stocked with various packaged goods line both sides, including refrigerated sections. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. The floor is reflective, and product labels are visible on shelves.

objects.label: hot air balloon decoration
objects.observation: A blue-and-white striped hot air balloon hangs from the ceiling near the center-right of the frame. It is suspended by an unseen support and partially obscures the view of items on the shelf below it.

objects.label: hot air balloon decoration
objects.observation: An orange-and-white striped hot air balloon hangs from the ceiling in the upper right corner. It is suspended by an unseen support and does not obscure any visible objects.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: A long glass-fronted refrigerated unit runs along the left wall, filled with beverages and dairy products. Its top edge is visible at the bottom left of the frame, and its glass door reflects overhead lighting.

objects.label: shelf with packaged goods
objects.observation: A tall metal shelf on the left side holds multiple rows of colorful packaged snacks and drinks. The top shelf is partially obscured by a red sign above it.

objects.label: shelf with packaged goods
objects.observation: A tall metal shelf on the right side holds bags of chips and other snacks. A wire basket filled with bottled drinks sits on the lower shelf, and the top shelf contains more snack packages.

objects.label: ceiling light fixture
objects.observation: A long fluorescent light fixture runs horizontally across the ceiling near the top left. It illuminates the area directly below and casts reflections on the floor.

objects.label: red promotional sign
objects.observation: A red sign with white Chinese characters is mounted above the left shelf. It reads '就要可口可乐' (Just Coca-Cola) and is partially obscured by the shelf's edge.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000001", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
